preamble: Down clues are normal. Each across entry consists of two words which ‘collide’, i.e. they overlap by one or more letters, the overlapping letters always appearing in their correct order. Across clues, except 12, consist of deÞnitions of each of the full overlapping words and subsidiary indications of each minus the overlapping letters. DeÞnition and subsidiary indication for one answer precede those for the other, but either may come Þrst. Numbers in brackets indicate the lengths of complete entries. Competitors should submit with their entries a clue in the style of the other acrosses to the ‘collision’ at 12 Across, here clued solely by deÞnitions for its two component words in their alphabetical order.
